html:
G'oya

Shartni to'plamlar tilida yozamiz: (SQL talabalari ∪ Python talabalari) ∩ sertifikati borlar. Qavslar shu yerda muhim, va ularni so'rovda ham saqlash kerak.

Yechim

SELECT id, name
FROM students
WHERE id IN (
  SELECT student_id FROM (
    SELECT student_id FROM enrollments WHERE course = 'SQL'
    UNION
    SELECT student_id FROM enrollments WHERE course = 'Python'
  ) t
  INTERSECT
  SELECT student_id FROM certificates
)

Birlashma hosila jadval ichida turibdi, shuning uchun u kesishmadan oldin bajariladi, qaysi bazada ishlashidan qat'i nazar.

Tuzoqlar

Qavssiz yozilgan so'rov ikki bazada har xil ishlaydi:

Noto'g'riSELECT id, name FROM students
WHERE id IN (
  SELECT student_id FROM enrollments WHERE course = 'SQL'
  UNION
  SELECT student_id FROM enrollments WHERE course = 'Python'
  INTERSECT
  SELECT student_id FROM certificates
)

SQLite to'plam amallarini chapdan o'ngga bajaradi va bu so'rov unda to'g'ri ishlaydi. PostgreSQL esa SQL standartiga amal qiladi: INTERSECT UNIONdan kuchliroq, xuddi ko'paytirish qo'shishdan kuchliroq bo'lgani kabi. U so'rovni SQL ∪ (Python ∩ sertifikat) deb o'qiydi va namunada sertifikati yo'q Aziz bilan Bekzod ham nomzod bo'lib qoladi.

Sertifikatlar jadvalini JOIN qilsangiz, DISTINCT kerak bo'ladi. Namunada Sardorning ikkita sertifikati bor va u ikkala kursga yozilgan, JOIN uni to'rt marta chiqaradi.

Boshqa yo'l

To'plam amallarisiz, ikkita IN bilan:

SELECT id, name
FROM students
WHERE id IN (SELECT student_id FROM enrollments WHERE course IN ('SQL', 'Python'))
  AND id IN (SELECT student_id FROM certificates)
